listings.rawTitle: Anna Sui Flight of Fancy Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Adventurer Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Voyager Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Aramis Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

Like a soft melody, Eternity for women plays with the fragrance notes and creates a memorable perfume composition. The fragrance tones are quite feminine in style, with the floral scent prominent in the chic bottle of Eternity Calvin Klein. The sophisticated yet timelessly elegant and simple scent is what we love about the Calvin Klein brand. Eternity for women steps even higher by delivering a mixture of a bouquet of beautiful flowers and the spicy nuances of golden amber and sandalwood. The complete effect is a woodsy appealing scent that is hard to resist.   Calvin Klein, the leading global lifestyle company, has long been a leader in the perfume/cologne market, having achieved great success with its CK One Unisex release in 1994. 2011's follow-up, One Shock for Him 200ml, reaffirmed One Shock's position with men, featuring a new carefully blended fragrance representative of CK's modern and authentic style.   One Shock for Him, created for you.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci L'Extase Caresse Roses Legere Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Florale Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=R5DSO15]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Prada Candy Florale is a playful and elegant fragrance that captures a sense of youthful charm with a refined floral twist. Launched in 2014, Prada Candy Florale follows the success of Candy L’Eau and continues the legacy of the iconic Candy collection. listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Gloss Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Kiss Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy L'Eau Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray

Playful and seductive, this perfume is a fantastic choice from the luxury brand.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray

The bottle and packaging are inspired by the technological excellence and sleek, dynamic beauty of extreme sailing boats, both displaying the iconic red Prada stripe. The backbone of the fragrance is Lavender- an unmistakable natural ingredient in perfumery- teamed with a bitter freshness of Orange essence, resulting in a fresh and invigorating scent. Aromatic Clary Sage and Spearmint Nanah Essences channel the spirit of vast open spaces and rugged, natural elements, richly nuanced and sublime.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TI239S5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Mont Blanc Aftershave is one of the top fragrance brands in the world. The brand offers a scent experience which is second to none. You may already have tried other offerings from the brand. One of the more exciting fragrance options the brand offers is Mont Blanc Emblem. When you are looking for a fragrance that is perfect for both daytime and night time wear, it is the perfect choice. What does Mont Blanc Emblem Aftershave smell like? It is packed with male scents including clary sage, cinnamon and cardamom. As a final offering, you will also pick up on notes of violet leaf, wood and cinnamon. It must be said that this is a very masculine scent. We are offering Mont Blanc Emblem Intense which gives you a rich fragrance experience. Buy it for yourself as a pat on the back. If you are a lady looking for a truly masculine scent for your man, this is the one.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino I Love Love Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=RTR9EC8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Moschino I Love Love Eau De Toilette 100ml is a fragrance full of sunshine and bright colour, made to capture the feeling of being madly in love. A youthful floral woody scent with fruity accents, it's all about joy, optimism and playfulness, created in 2004 by perfumer Olivier Cresp. From the very first moments you can give in to a refreshing rush of grapefruit, orange and lemon, underscored by a tart redcurrant essence. A little later, a charming floral combination of tea rose, lily of the valley and juncus emerges, accompanied by delicately aromatic cinnamon leaf. The dry-down then settles into musk and rare woods, with cedar and thanaka wood adding a soft, warm finish. Bright and carefree, this generous 100ml size is a lovely everyday choice for anyone who loves fresh, citrussy florals with a gently woody base. An intoxicating, feel-good scent for women and girls who aren't afraid to be the centre of attention.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in September 2014 this fragrance opens up with fresh white gardenia and roses. The heart of the scent is created with warm musk. All wrapped in a base of vetiver and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in September 2014 this fragrance opens up with fresh white gardenia and roses. The heart of the scent is created with warm musk. All wrapped in a base of vetiver and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez L'Eau For Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The composition opens up with jasmine, cyclamen and sparkling pink peony, with rose. The middle notes of amber and frozen lily of the valley that form a silky veil. The base includes musk and chypre accords of patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: For Him is Narciso Rodriguez's first perfume for men. This mysterious fragrance is both surprising and seductive. For Him embodies the eternally masculine. For Him is a fougere accord whose heart of musks is enriched by 3 vibrations: floral aromatic, textured woods and sensual amber. A masculine signature, contemporary, elegant and sensual.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her L'Absolu Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: A floral woody musk fragrance that embodies the ultimate femininity with a pure grace. The composition contains intense floral accords of tuberose and jasmine absolute, the signature musk heart and the base of amber and woody tones of patchouli and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MONPY82]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} For Her Eau de Parfum maintains musk as its heart note, just like the other for her perfumes. Peach and rose are added to make this fragrance truly velvety. Meanwhile, a veil of soft amber and wood adds mystery and depth to the composition. Even with more intensity, the for her Eau de Parfum harmonises it against the guiding simplicity of the for her line.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The first and most important quality of a fragrance should be its ability to tell a story. Every story has a beginning and for Narciso Rodriguez, that beginning was egyptian musk, his favourite scent, he was introduced to the mysterious essence by an unforgettable woman he met. Musk is at the heart of 'For Her', expressing itself through honey flower, radiant amber and tactile woody pulsations. The fragrant harmony develops gently, slowly, rounding out into the warm tones of sun-kissed skin, dusted in a soft, velvety sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Nautica Voyage Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Nautica Voyage N-83 by Nautica is an Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Nautica Voyage N-83 was launched in 2013. Top notes are sea notes, spicy mint and petitgrain; middle notes are cardamom, nutmeg and lavender; base notes are musk, sandalwood and cedar. Nautica N-83 personifies the primal sense of the forbidden, a lust for the unknown. Chart your course. Set your sails. Bon Voyage!

listings.rawTitle: Nautica Classic Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Nautica by Nautica is a Woody Chypre fragrance for men. Nautica was launched in 1992. Top notes are aldehydes, lime, coriander, cypress, cinnamon, tarragon, clary sage, neroli, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are cyclamen, jasmine, caraway, rose and geranium; base notes are sandalwood, amber, patchouli, musk, oakmoss and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Nautica Blue Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Nautica Blue is an exclusive perfume for men to enchant you with its freshness and lightness. Designed for dynamic and free men who need some space and wide horizons in their lives, but inside are fragile, tender, and incredibly sensual. The man wearing Blue is spontaneous and natural which just enchants every woman.

listings.rawTitle: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: NAUTICA VOYAGE SPORT captures the mind, body and heart it takes to endure and push beyond one's own limits. The new fragrance speaks to the man with a competitive spirit, who commits to every task.

listings.rawTitle: Nicki Minaj Onika Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q2BKU1Q]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Onika is a dynamic and irresistible women’s perfume that will turn heads wherever you go. The opening notes deliver fresh pear, mandarin orange and starfruit - juicy and attention-grabbing. Following the top notes, the perfume’s sensuous heart bursts into full bloom with orchid, water lily and osmanthus in an accord that will have you feeling like royalty. As the perfume settles fully on the skin, it concludes with the warmth of cedar and white musk, accented by sweet sugar cane.

listings.rawTitle: Nicki Minaj Pink Friday Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Pink Friday is the debut fragrance for Nicki Minaj. An intoxicating floral musky fragrance mixing playful fruity notes with pink flower petals, creamy vanilla, musk and woods.

listings.rawTitle: Nicki Minaj The Pink Print Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The Pinkprint opens with a fresh mixture that includes bergamot, pink grapefruit and passion fruit. The heart is composed of nectarine, frangipani, orange blossom, heliotrope and roses. Coconut, driftwood accord, sandalwood, patchouli and skin musk end the composition.

listings.rawTitle: Nicki Minaj Trini Girl Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity fragrance with top notes of litchi, blood orange, quince, and sorbet, heart notes of apple blossom, Trinidadian chaconia flower, and dewy leaves, and base notes of coconut and white musk.

listings.rawTitle: Nikos Sculpture Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Whilst the international fashion house of Nikos was founded in Paris, its ideology is deeply rooted in Greek mythology.Everything about the brand celebrates the phsical beauty, the iconic presence, and the heroic eroticism of modern gods.Sculptured from this ideal, an iconic fragrance was born.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Premier Jour Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MVEX4R3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This popular Nina Ricci perfume is a very feminine and sensual scent for modern women. The opening notes of mandarin orange and sweet pea melt into a fresh bouquet of gardenia and orchid on a comforting base of sandalwood, musk and vanilla. Premier Jour has been released as Eau de Parfum and Eau de Toilette, and you can also enjoy this sweet and enchanting scent as body lotion or as part of a gift set.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci L'Air du Temps Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by the design house of Nina Ricci in 1948, L'AIR DU TEMPS by Nina Ricci possesses a blend of a rich floral of gardenia and jasmine, with tones of sandalwood and iris, a romantic aroma. It is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar De La Renta So De La Renta Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: So de la Renta by Oscar de la Renta is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. So de la Renta was launched in 1997. The nose behind this fragrance is Ilias Ermenidis. Top notes are clementine, kiwi, gardenia, freesia, mango, watermelon and cardamom; middle notes are peony, tuberose, jasmine sambac, lotus and narcissus; base notes are plum, musk and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Pour Lui Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by Oscar de la Renta in 1981, Pour Lui is an evening fragrance that explores essences of Lavender. clove and musk and a dry and woodsy blend.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Oscar For Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Oscar for Men by Oscar De La Renta, Launched by the design house of oscar de la renta in 1977. Its fragrant nature explores essences of bergamot, fern and vetiver. Blended with notes of cinnamon, acarnation and moss, oscar is a romantic type of fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Oscar For Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VQQ15W8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Oscar De La Renta Oscar is a floral and feminine scent, joyously fragrant with an abundant floral bouquet and soft, woody accents. Released in 1977, it is the first Oscar De La Renta fragrance and is as timeless as their sophisticated fashion designs. This fragrance opens with a bouquet of flowers which blend with its sweet, musky heart and base notes. Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Basil, Coriander, Galbanum, Peach and Gardenia. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang, Jasmine, Tuberose, Rose, Rosemary, Cyclamen, Lavender and Orchid. Base Notes: Opoponax, Carnation, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Lavender and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Gentleman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The fragrance is said to be Bold, invigorating, smooth and captivating. The woody - fougere composition begins with a chilled bergamot, sparkling grapefruit, cardamom and champagne accord. A blend of Egyptian geranium and rosemary, together with black oolong tea, leads to the base of intense amber, labdanum, vetiver and leatherwood.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Flor Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Inspired by Oscar de la Renta’s love for gardening, his signature scent has been reimagined with Oscar Flor. The fragrance sparkles with fresh-picked mango and lush neroli then warms with creamy musk for an elegant finish. Natural, bright, fragrant.

listings.rawTitle: Oscar de La Renta Extraordinary Petale Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Invigorating citrusy notes of bergamot and mandarin are mixed with a sparkling accord of champagne in the top of the composition. Orange blossom, rose and jasmine form a classic floral bouquet in the heart of the fragrance. Vanilla orchid, musk and amber finish the base with their warmth.

listings.rawTitle: One Direction That Moment Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: The soft fragrance is made up of splashes of fresh fruit and seasonal flowers infused with an undertone of musk. The smell of green apple and refreshing cucumber, combined with peony and violet and a hint of cedarwood offers all the excitement of new beginnings. The fragrance is housed in an intricate pink glass bottle, complimented with a unique exclusive glass 'diamond' giving the bottle a stunning, luxurious finish.

listings.rawTitle: One Direction Our Moment Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Our Moment is the debut fragrance by superstar boy band One Direction and features top notes of pink grapefruit, wild berries and redcurrant; followed by a heart of jasmine petals, fresh freesias and frangipani on a base of creamy musk, sheer woods and white patchouli. A beautiful first fragrance by 1D.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Inhale the scent of victory with Invictus, the masculine fragrance by Paco Rabanne. This sensually fresh scent sets a modern vision of masculinity. Invictus is an unexpected clash of worlds, powers, sensations, and values: a thrill of pure freshness in the top note faces the sensuality of a guaiac wood base note.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Ultraviolet Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created for a new generation of men, Ultraviolet Man is based on the rare mineral ambergris. It has masculine, sensual, woody-amber undertones blended with liquid mint, organic vetiver, and moss crystals.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Ultraviolet Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: Ultraviolet embodies a spiritual and radiant world. It is a modern, sensual and seductive floral oriental fragrance for women that is ideal for office wear. Top notes of orange pepper, brazilian rosewood and fresh almond together with apricot and coriander open the fragrance, leading to the heart of Japanese osmanthus, violet, jasmine and rose, with a base of vanilla, amber, patchouli and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Splash
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Pour Homme is the incarnation of the style, the irresistible self-confidence and charisma of the eternal seducer. Launched in 1973, this is an elegant, spicy, lavender, amber fragrance. It contains rosemary, lavender, bergamot, accented with sage, carnation and cedar and is perfect for both casual and formal wear.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Pour Homme is the incarnation of the style, the irresistible self-confidence and charisma of the eternal seducer. Launched in 1973, this is an elegant, spicy, lavender, amber fragrance. It contains rosemary, lavender, bergamot, accented with sage, carnation and cedar and is perfect for both casual and formal wear.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Paco Rabanne olympia, also known as “Olympea”, is a fantastic women’s fragrance. This perfume opens with a heavy vanilla note that is partnered with ginger and jasmine, making it unique and inviting. Later the fragrance’s sweet and woody scent begins to emerge, sitting close to the skin while sensually calling out. This is a great fragrance for every season, but its green mandarin note really comes to life on cold nights. This fragrance suits every situation, whether it be a date night, or a formal setting. If you are someone that desires a sexy scent that is youthful, mysterious and seductive, then this Olympea perfume is a must have. A versatile perfume that invites compliments, just as the beautiful 50ml bottle does. It’s enticing curves draw you in as much as the fragrance itself.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Prive Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SAQDCC7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lady Million Perfume continues to bring out new exciting fragrances and add to its collection. When you need a fragrance which is not run of the mill, this is the perfect perfume brand to turn to. Lady Million continues to dare to be different. One of the latest offerings from Paco Rabanne Lady Million is Prive. This is perhaps a slightly more sophisticated fragrance. It works well during the night as well as the day. If you like, it is a bit easier on the senses. It is sweet and fresh while offering sensual notes including patchouli and a touch of spice. Perfume Price offers this exciting eau de parfum in an 80ml format. It makes an excellent gift or personal purchase. If you have tried other scents from this particular collection from Rabanne, this makes an excellent addition when you want to expand your choice of perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Prive Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NT03KPM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lady Million Perfume never lets you down. It is a range of fun and vibrant fragrances that continues to grow. If you are looking for a fragrance with a difference. Lady Million always has something to offer. It is versatile, creative and adventurous. Many of the same qualities which fit in well with the modern woman. Paco Rabanne Million now offers Prive. What does it smell like? Although sweet, it has deeper nuances as well. Let the scent fully develop and you soon pick up on warm spices and cacao. Patchouli also helps to deliver the more sensual side of this fragrance. It is a lovely scent which works well during the day as well as the night. If you are new to the fragrance, we are offering you the opportunity to try it. It is available from us in a 50 ml format. Why not order this eau de parfum for yourself? The fragrance also makes a wonderful gift to someone who appreciates more refined and sophisticated fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau my Gold Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: The freshness of Lady MILLION Eau My Gold! conveys exuberant luxury and the fantasy of an extraordinary show. This floral fruity fragrance embodies festive moods and simple pleasures. The diamond-shaped bottle is elongated and almost totally transparent.  Opens with a top note of mango accompanied by grapefruit, a middle note of orange flower absolute and violet finished with a base note of musk and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CW67TI5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lady Million perfume is one of those fragrances ladies of all ages should have in their scent collection. It is fun and vibrant and likes to make a splash. Do you own a bottle? If not, now is the perfect opportunity to try the fragrance and find out what it has to offer. What can you expect from Lady Million? This is an intense set that likes to show off. It is packed with vibrant notes including neroli and bitter orange. Let the fragrance linger, and raspberry back up by jasmine and orange blossom burst out of the bottle. Paco Rabanne Lady Million is certainly a fragrance with a difference. Perfume price is offering the fragrance in a 50ml eau de parfum bottle. Order a bottle for yourself or buy it as a gift. This is a special fragrance treat which is always appreciated and well-received by ladies of all ages.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NICSXSK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Invictus is a premier range of men’s fragrances. When you have not updated your personal fragrance collection in a while, Paco Rabanne Invictus offers you the perfect opportunity to do so. This is a men’s cologne which fits in during the day and night time. It has a wide range of tones which makes it perfect for almost any occasion when you need a more refined fragrance. What does it smell like? It is sensual and masculine at the same time. Sensual and masculine notes are derived from amber and touches of camphor. The fresher notes which make the cologne stand out come from lemon, marine and aquatic notes. In other words, this is a men’s fragrance with many layers. It is an exquisite cologne that many men have not discovered yet. We are delighted to offer you the chance to test drive Invictus Paco Rabanne. Take this opportunity to buy the cologne in a 50ml format for yourself. Also, we feel we should point out that the fragrance also makes a much-appreciated gift or present for the man in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J8RW0J7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Invictus is without a shadow of a doubt one of the best fragrances for men in the world. When you are thinking about updating your collection, exploring what the brand has to offer is an excellent idea. One of the premier fragrances offered by this top-class perfume is Paco Rabanne Invictus. What can you expect from Invictus Paco Rabanne? This fragrance is both sensual and fresh. Its freshness is derived from citrus, aquatic and marine notes. Masculine and sensual tones come from wood, amber and a touch of camphor. Fresh spices add a finishing touch with a slight salty flourish. It truly is both refreshing and masculine. Perfume Price offers this sophisticated eau de toilette in a 150ml spray format. Why not buy Invictus Paco Rabanne for yourself so that you always have an exclusive cologne at the ready? The fragrance also makes a great gift for someone who appreciates fine scents.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Refillable Eau de Parfum 25ml Spray
listings.description: Angel, released by Thierry Mugler in 1992, is a refreshing, oriental, woody scent recommended for daytime wear. It explores essences of honey, chocolate and caramel and has notes of vanilla, sandalwood, and patchouli, accompanied by fruity notes of fresh citrus, melons, peaches, and plums.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Angel perfume has stood the test of time. Thierry Mugler is one of the few fashion designers that has a real passion for perfume. Unlike so many other perfumes, this amazing scent was not rushed onto the market. Instead, the product team behind Angel by Thierry Mugler took its time to bring it to the market. It has now been with us since 1992 and remains as popular as it was when it was first released. There is little wonder why. The tones of the perfume are exquisite. The core of the of the perfume is essential oil of patchouli. That clearly comes through. When you let the perfume linger for a while, you pick up the rest of the fragrance mix. With its beautiful undertones of vanilla and a pleasant sweet smell, Thierry Mugler Angel is one of the perfumes that always makes a perfect gift. The 50ml bottle looks fantastic on a dressing table. Thanks to its unique design, it is one of the few perfume bottles that can be called a keepsake.

listings.rawTitle: Tous Man Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Tous Man Sport Cologne by Tous, Introduced in 2010, tous man sport is a signature creation by tous . The mastermind behind this fragrance is the perfumer vincent salaire from firmenich. Men who want to sport an adventurous spirit will be pleased with this perfume. The fragrance bursts open with energetic top notes of lemon, aldehydes, and woody cedars. Exotic middle notes of ginger and apple fill the heart notes, while cashmere, musk, atlas cedar, and oak mass form the base of the fragrance for a refreshing and soothing effect. The perfume is contained in a modern curvy glass flacon that is blue in color and has the brand and product names written in silver.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Valentina Assoluto Intense Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: Valentino Valentina Assoluto eau de parfum spray for women is a floral and earthy perfume, opening with top notes of bergamot, peach and truffle, blending with a heart of tuberose, jasmine and vanilla, all of which is rounded off with a smooth base of cedar, oak moss and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Truly Pink Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Truly Pink by Vera Wang has top notes that bring us apricot and litchi united with white freesia, a hear of pink rose, lily of the valley and peony settled on a base of creamy woodsy notes and iris. The embodiment of pure femininity, enchating and forever in bloom.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Sheer Veil Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: This limited 2005 edition brings us the floral bliss of Champagne rose and lavender. The heart is touched by delicate powdery notes of dewy violet that wrap the luscious dream rose like a veil. The base intoxicates with pure and sweet intensive notes of white Stephanotis, gardenia and white lily.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Princess Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Radiant and whimsical. A charming, fruity vanilla. Sparkling in a breeze of Lady Apple and Waterlily. Sweeping her into Ripe Pink Guava and Tahitian Tiare Flower. Tempted to taste with Dark Chocolate and Pink Frosting Accord, Forbidden Woods and Chiffon Vanilla. Jewel cut heart shaped bottle topped with a gold crown cap adorned with purple gems. Vera Wang Princess is for those 'Born To Rule'. The contradiction of a modern day princess. Playful and unpredictable. Uniquely feminine with an edge. A spirit for adventure.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Princess Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Radiant and whimsical. A charming, fruity vanilla. Sparkling in a breeze of Lady Apple and Waterlily. Sweeping her into Ripe Pink Guava and Tahitian Tiare Flower. Tempted to taste with Dark Chocolate and Pink Frosting Accord, Forbidden Woods and Chiffon Vanilla. Jewel cut heart shaped bottle topped with a gold crown cap adorned with purple gems. Vera Wang Princess is for those 'Born To Rule'. The contradiction of a modern day princess. Playful and unpredictable. Uniquely feminine with an edge. A spirit for adventure.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang For Her Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UBNTUX2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The Vera Wang fragrance is a golden colour, modern, floral bouquet that is at once sensual and intimate. The scent, developed by Firmenich, begins on a top note of Bulgarian rose, calla lily and mandarin flower. The middle note of gardenia, lotus, iris and white stephanotis is based on a note of sheer musks, white woods and floral nectar.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H5QR629]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Meet your addiction, Spicebomb Eau de Toilette, Viktor&Rolf’s explosive fragrance for men. A weapon of mass seduction, pull the trigger to encounter a highly addictive scent. Brace yourself for the strong sensory contrasts and be engulfed by the balmy, woody Vetiver trail. Be engulfed by fresh and zesty top notes of Bergamot and Grapefruit while cold spices, Elemi and Pink Pepper, leave their icy bite. Brace yourself for the heart of incandescent spices, Chilli and Saffron, fused with a masculine base of Leather and Tobacco along with the distinguished strength of Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Full-bodied and opulent, Flowerbomb is a floral explosion, a profusion of flowers that has the power to make everything seem more positive. Top notes: Tea and bergamot. Middle notes: Sambac jasmine, orchid, freesia, rose. Base note: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Full-bodied and opulent, Flowerbomb is a floral explosion, a profusion of flowers that has the power to make everything seem more positive. Top notes: Tea and bergamot. Middle notes: Sambac jasmine, orchid, freesia, rose. Base note: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent  Manifesto Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: The composition is developed by Anne Flipo and Loc Dong. It starts off with fresh green wave, bergamot and black currant. The heart includes accords of white flowers such as Sambac jasmine and lily of the valley. The base is woody and slightly oriental and captures notes of cedar, sandalwood, vanilla and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Paris Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: A city dedicated to love, a designer in love with women: it was inevitable that these two would come together around the most elegant, the most romantic and the most Parisian of women's fragrances.Created in 1983 using the rose, his emblem-flower, conjuring up like no other the atmosphere of the city whose name it bears, this mythical fragrance celebrates women in love. Elegant and refined women, full of sparkle and spontaneity, confident about their seductive powers.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Paris Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: A city dedicated to love, a designer in love with women: it was inevitable that these two would come together around the most elegant, the most romantic and the most Parisian of women's fragrances.Created in 1983 using the rose, his emblem-flower, conjuring up like no other the atmosphere of the city whose name it bears, this mythical fragrance celebrates women in love. Elegant and refined women, full of sparkle and spontaneity, confident about their seductive powers.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Paris Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F8UW1LF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} An elegant and vivacious scent, Yves Saint Laurent Paris eau de toilette spray for women opens top notes of mimosa, orange blossom, green notes, rose and bergamot, fusing with a heart of lily, violet, jasmine, ylang ylang and lily of the valley, atop a smooth base of orris, sandalwood, amber, musk and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Opium Pour Homme by Yves Saint Laurent is a masculine fragrance designed to evoke the strength, sensuality and the mystery of the Orient in a fresh, sensual and oriental harmony. Opium Pour Homme is made up of notes of star anise and blackcurrant to open the scent; then moves into a spicy heart of galanga and pepper; and finishes with base notes of cedar, balsam, and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Trailing from a place of warm and exotic mystery, Yves Saint Laurent Opium is a spicy oriental fragrance melding a wild flurry of ingredients into an enticing and sumptuous blend.</span><br /><br /><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Opening in a kick of cloves, coriander and pepper it starts warm and spicy, offset delicately by rivulets of sweet plum and mandarin orange.</span><br /><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Melting back the fragrance presents a core of aromatic carnation and rose backed with poignant cinnamon and a mingling of sandalwood.</span><br /><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Ultimately the fragrance mellows into a sensual and spiritual myriad combining incense, myrrh, opoponax and rich amber amongst a forest of flavours that provide a truly unique and luxurious treat.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'Homme Eau de Toilette 60ml Spray
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Frozen Cologne is an icy-cold fragrance ideal for the summer. This fragrance is aimed at men who enjoy elegant, powerful and masculine compositions. The power of this fragrance is reflected in icy-cold notes, in luminous sweet citruses and charming nuances of tart spices and wood. The composition opens with bergamot combined with mandarin and lemon. This citrusy opening is a cold and refreshing overture to the heart of cold and tart black pepper and geranium, while the base closes with a mixture of vetiver, cedar, tonka and cashmere.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H7OH4XC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} La Nuit de L’Homme is a fragrance that tells a story of irresistible seduction and unapologetic intensity. Designed for the man who exudes confidence and allure, it captures the essence of bold sensuality and effortless charm. His presence is magnetic—sweeping away everything in his path with quiet power and undeniable appeal. A fresh oriental fragrance that thrives on contrast, it balances vibrant energy with deep, captivating warmth. The top notes open with the cool spice of cardamom, setting a dynamic and refined tone. At its heart, the smooth sophistication of cedarwood adds structure and elegance, while coumarin brings a rich, velvety sensuality to the base—creating a magnetic pull that lingers. This scent thrives on dualities: fresh yet warm, refined yet daring. It’s a bold signature for the modern man who walks the line between control and passion. A fragrance that doesn’t just leave an impression—it makes a statement.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Sport Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Racy and bold, this Fragrance is full of intensity. The freshness of bergamot and aldehyde provides an adrenaline rush. The heart of cardamom is warmed with the scent of cedar & a base of woody amber.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Libre Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Libre Eau de Toilette is an expression of passion, energy and modernity that is more than a fragrance: it's a state of mind. The L'Homme Libre man lives his life off-tempo. He is free to change his mind at a moment's notice for he moves to his own insatiable rhythm. His woody aromatic scent reflects his fresh take on life, with perfumers Olivier Polge and Carlos Benaim crafting a completely modern creation that is all at once progressive and serene. The woody architecture of patchouli and vetiver structure a surprising fragrance that includes notes of violet, basil, star anise and nutmeg. A resolutely masculine, classic scent with an unexpected touch of electric transparency.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JBBEOIB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Described as having the sensual warmth of orange bourbon sour, YSL L'Homme Eau de Parfum is a stronger, more intense and warmer twist on the original Eau de Toilette. L'Homme Eau de Parfum opens with a sparkling infusion of bitter orange before developing into a cocktail of vetiver and geranium for a sophisticated heart. Lastly, sustainably-sourced wood chips, which have been upcycled from oak casks add an aromatic and warm profile that lingers on the skin for a sensual finish. Top note is Bitter Orange. Heart notes are Vetiver and Geranium. Base note is Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette 60ml Spray
listings.description: A fresh woody fragrance with notes of citrus peel, ginger, basil blossoms, violet leaves, vetiver and tonka bean. Intense, charismatic freshness (Chinese Ginger) contrasts against a powerful body (Basil) with a bold and sexy trail (Cedar Wood).

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WQVWK2G]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fragrance for the urban and charismatic 21st century male. In a sparkling opening, Bergamot and Cedarwood bring luminosity, sustained with Chinese Ginger. The middle floral spicy notes contrast with this first note of freshness: the modern masculinity of Violet leaves and Basil flowers, and the resonance of White Pepper. Base notes of Sandalwood, Virginia Cedarwood and Haitian Vetiver highlight this charismatic fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=O1SO5K2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fragrance for the urban and charismatic 21st century male. In a sparkling opening, Bergamot and Cedarwood bring luminosity, sustained with Chinese Ginger. The middle floral spicy notes contrast with this first note of freshness: the modern masculinity of Violet leaves and Basil flowers, and the resonance of White Pepper. Base notes of Sandalwood, Virginia Cedarwood and Haitian Vetiver highlight this charismatic fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Silver Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A newer, more modern version of the classic fragrance, launched in 1981. It is fresher and cooler than the original, beginning with a top note of Green Apple Accord, flourishing into a heart of Sage Essence, and finishing with a base of Ambery Wood Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Elle Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: Unpredictable and unique, Elle is the essence of Yves Saint Laurent femininity. Her bottle celebrates the prestigious, interlaced monogram, cut from metal the color of gold, highlighted with vibrant, luminous legendary fuchsia.Her fragrance is unique and unexpected. An ultra contemporary creation, fluid and unrestrained. A vibrantly feminine and audacious fragrance that blends dazzling woody and floral notes.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Nuit Blanche Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Nuit Blanche translates to "White Night", a night in Paris once a year when rock chicks take control and make the city their playground until dawn. With the iconic white floral heart of the original Black Opium, this fragrance is electrified with a burst of energizing aldehydes and white musk for an all night adventure.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Black Opium is the new fragrance from Yves Saint Laurent. This new scent is inspired by the dark and mysterious side of the brand. The latest in the Opium collection this fragrance opens with notes of coffee, complimented by accords of pink pepper, which lead you to the heart of vanilla, jasmine and orange blossom, drawing to a close with base notes of cedar and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Mon Paris dresses up head to toe in pink sparkles to celebrate the holiday season! The glitter firework design adds an extra touch of romance to a fragrance that captures the spirit of an intense love affair. Mon Paris Eau de Parfum captivates from the first moment with top notes of fresh, juicy fruits, while intoxicating datura flower creates an ultra-pure radiance. The white floral notes are bound with patchouli and balanced with sensual musk.

listings.rawTitle: Beyonce Rise Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Beyonce launches Rise in February of 2014. The concept that lies behind the creation of this fragrance was inspired by Beyonce’s on-stage persona, as well as by “female empowerment and finding the inner strength that makes women so beautiful" . Opening notes include apricot, Italian bergamot and iced basil sorbet. The main note of the perfume is, of course, orchid and this time it is an orchid called Golden Symphony, which is mixed with freesia and Sambac jasmine flowers and placed at the base of the autumn woods, cashmere, musk and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome United Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro Chrome United Eau De Toilette, a fragrance that evokes a privileged moment among friends, the strength of ties to unity and the pleasure of moments shared.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Brit Sheer Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KIO4Y3J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Burberry Brit Sheer Eau de Toilette is a fragrance that radiates optimism and lightness, capturing the warmth of sunshine in a fresh and modern way. Juicy bursts of tangerine, yuzu, litchi and pineapple leaf open the scent with a vibrant energy that feels instantly uplifting. At its heart, soft floral notes of peony and peach blossom unfold with delicate charm, balanced by the subtle sweetness of pear. This airy bouquet gives the fragrance a graceful femininity that feels effortless and joyful, perfectly suited for everyday wear. The base lingers with the clean sensuality of white musk and light woods, leaving a trail that is both elegant and easy to wear. Introduced in 2015, Burberry Brit Sheer continues the brand’s legacy of timeless style, housed in a bottle adorned with the iconic Burberry check.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man Black Cologne Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A fresh oriental with a supremely modern spirit, Bvlgari's Man Black Cologne is an eau de toilette for the refined gentleman. Infused with a myriad of contrasting facets, it opens with notes of fresh green citrus fruit. An elegant heart of tuberose and neroli soften the scent, leading into a rich base of amber, white wood and musk. Characterised by an intense, sensuous freshness; the unambitious man need not apply.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man in Black Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PILKMN5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} With Bvlgari Man in Black, Bvlgari expresses the impetuous and mysterious character of fire, a transformative element symbolizing strength and energy. A magnetic fragrance with notes of rum, leather and vibrant spices that creates a daring and charismatic new statement of masculinity. A sensual ambery eau de parfum inspired by raw power of fire. Fragrance Family: Ambery Spicy Top Notes : Vibrant Spices Middle Notes: Tuberose Flower Base Note: Benzoin

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Splendida Iris D'Or Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: With Splendida Iris d'Or, the perfumer Sophie Labbé has kept the star ingredients that contributed to the success of the classic BVLGARI Pour Femme; and has exhalted them. A mysterious and sophisticated aura: dark and luminous, the Splendida Iris d'Or woman strides across the world with regal allure, brave enough to express the depth of her emotions. She evokes the diva assoluta that radiated from modern Italian cinema in the sixties.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsessed Intense For Men Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: Obsessed Intense by Calvin Klein is the deeper exploration of a story of past love and romance. Unbound by traditional female and male fragrance structures, the two perfumes know no rules. Genders are subverted and layered, with the traditional scents of the masculine fougère —particularly white lavender—harnessed for the women’s fragrance, while the men’s scent is in thrall to a dark vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Red Edition for Her Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: CK one Red Edition for women by Calvin Klein offers a new expression of freshness: uniquely energizing, yet daring and intense. The fragrance opens with the bold vibrant freshness of juicy watermelon and violet which fuses with a burst of succulent fruits for a mélange of forbidden exploration. The notes are feminine and addictive, composed of warm white amber, sensual patchouli and intimate skin musk, to create a powerful blend of undeniable magnetism and seduction.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity Intense from Calvin Klein was released in 2016. The fragrance is made using a touch of a sensual and rare iris flower and represents a passionate and unbreakable connection.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Intense Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity for Men Intense from Calvin Klein was released in 2016. The fragrance is made using a touch of a sensual and rare iris flower and represents a passionate and unbreakable connection.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsessed For Men Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: At the heart of OBSESSED FOR MEN is the memory of a past love, triggered by the scent of another on the skin. Genders are subverted and layered with the traditionally feminine note - dark vanilla - harnessed for the men’s fragrance, which together with amber and woods strengthen the sense of masculinity in the men’s fragrance. It is this tension, a compulsive push and pull that makes the wearer return to the fragrances time and again.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: New for 2013 is Lacoste L12.12 Noir, a great scent for men that features both woodsy and oriental notes to create a strong and masculine fragrance. An ideal everyday fragrance for men, Lacoste L12.12 Noir features top notes of Watermelon, heart notes of Verbena, Lavender and Basil and base notes of Patchouli, Coumarin, Cashmeran and Dark Chocolate, an interesting

listings.rawTitle: Lanvin Eclat D'Arpege Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=W9V6G5E]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} This beautiful and enchanting composition opens up with accords of delicate green lilac and aromatic Sicilian lemon leaves which slowly lead to the heart of the fragrance, made of lush wisteria blossom, revitalizing white tea leaves, peach blossom and sensual peony. The fragrant base consists of white cedar, soft musk and precious amber that enrich the essence of the fragrance and gives the effect of a velvety embrace. Fall in love with this delightful and refreshing perfume, inspired by the beauty of nature, and enjoy the moments of happiness that this floral and cheerful aroma is going to provide you.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: An elegant, sensual, mysterious and voluptuous fragrance. Three notes enhance the heart of musk: floral-fruity, amber and woody notes. A bottle with a pink interior set off by thick glass. A deep-black box.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Intense Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=AAJ0CTS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Invictus was first launched in 2013. It is one of the premier collections from this top-class perfumer. When you are looking for a sophisticated scent that works both day and night, you should explore what this premier brand has to offer. One of its more popular ranges is called Paco Rabanne Invictus. Perfume Price is delighted to offer its clients the opportunity to buy Invictus Intense. This is a rather recent addition to the collection. It has to be said it has outstanding masculine nuances. The opening notes are fresh thanks to mandarin. Let the scent linger, and you pick up on classic male nuances including patchouli, bay leaf and leather. Ambergris and pepper add interest to the finishing motes. We offer you the opportunity to add this cologne to your collection as an eau de toilette in a 50ml format. This size is perfect for when travelling or when you need to freshen up after your gym workout. Buy it for yourself or treat the man in your life to it.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy L'Eau Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Candy L'Eau a fresh and joyful sensation of zestful and sweetly addictive notes. Citrus oriental floral blend of white musks, benzoin and caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Just Cavalli For Her Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Just Cavalli 2013 by Roberto Cavalli is described as creamy-floral and extremely sexy! Top notes of Just Cavalli offer luminous and sparkling drops of neroli, announcing the sexy heart created of Tahitian tiare flowers, along with warm, cuddly and creamy rosewood accords in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Salvatore Ferragamo Acqua Essenziale Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The high quality citruses and crispy green notes of mint and lemon tree leaf strengthen the freshness and provides a casual vibration to the top note. The heart reveals aromatic tonalities of elegant geranium, rosemary and lavender, shaken by a surprising twist of a cutting-edge molecule, the cascalone, which instils an aquatic breath to the fragrance. The dry down captures the distinctive style of woods, patchouli and vetiver and the comfort of cistus; an authentic signature that dives into the modernity of helveltolide, a new musk playing with its floral uniqueness.

listings.rawTitle: Salvatore Ferragamo F by Ferragamo Black Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A bold, intense fragrance for confident gentlemen that is masculine, mysterious, elegant & sensual.Features notes of lavender absolute, black pepper and blended with coriander seed, labdanum, tonka. Perfect for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Salvatore Ferragamo Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Salvatore Ferragamo Pour Homme by Salvatore Ferragamo is a woody floral musk fragrance for men and was launched in 1999. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Pierre Mary. Top notes are cyclamen, caraway, african geranium, fig leaf, grapefruit, neroli and brazilian rosewood; middle notes are carnation, orris root, jasmine, rose and cardamom; base notes are leather, sandalwood, musk, oakmoss, vetiver and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Acqua Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Valentino - A contemporary exploration of freshness and intensity, Valentino Uomo Acqua Eau de Toilette is inspired by the dissonant harmony of modern desire. Composed by Alexis Dadier and Sophie Labbé, sage essence and patchouli is laced with mandarin orange, green tomato and citron and sensual base notes of leather and iris.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Flower Princess Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Flower Princess by Vera Wang is a floral-fruity composition with green ivy notes, tangerine and lotus in the top. The heart unites orange blossom petals, Moroccan rose, jasmine Sambac and mimosa, while the base notes bring peach peel notes, amber, precious woods accords and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Glam Princess Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: This fun, flirtatious addition to the Princess line is for the boldly brilliant girl who is ready to celebrate and rule the world in the most glamorous way. She introduces herself with guava and juicy pear, reveals her beautiful heart with liquid honey and vanilla orchid, and offers sweet depth with marshmallow accord and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Lovestruck Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: This sparkling, romantic fragrance by Vera Wang encapsulates the smell of falling love with its delicious and enticing notes of pink guava and mandarin, followed by the delicate scent of tuberose and lotus. This is all supported on a strong and lasting foundation of musky and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Preppy Princess Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Preppy Princess is a juicy and luscious woody - fruity fragrance that combines top notes of tangerine, red apple and crushed red berries with a floral core of honeysuckle and jasmine, placed on sensual base notes of woods and coconut water.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Rock Princess Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Princess Night by Vera Wang is classified as a blend of exotic flowers, fruits and woody tones. The top oozes with wild berries, watermelon and raspberry. The composition’s core is formed of jasmine petals, spiced orange blossom and a touch of passionate rose, while the intensively sweet base features crushed sugar, vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Her Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: Y perfume by yves saint laurent, y is a woody, fruity fragrance from yvew saint laurent. The top notes include aldenhydes, peach, gardenia, mirabelle and honey suckle. Middle notes are bulgarian rose, jasmine, tuberose, ylang ylang, oris and hyacinth. Base notes of oak moss, amber, patchouli, sandal wood, vetiver, civet, benzoin and styrax. all products are original, authentic name brands.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Ultime Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: L'Homme Ultime is a woody floral musk fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. It was launched 2016. Top notes: grapefruit, ginger, cardamom, bergamot. Middle notes: rose, sage, geranium, apple. Base notes: cedar, vetiver, cashmere wood.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Pure Parfum Refill 75ml Spray
listings.description: Terre D'Hermes is for the man who is a poet by nature, someone who sees the extraordinary in the ordinary. This is for the man who has his feet firmly on the ground, but his head is in the stars..Terre D'Hermès contains a large amount of woody notes, including Atlas cedar. It's also a mix of grapefruit, effervescent orange, gunflint, silex, pepper, baies roses, geranium leaves, patchouli, vetiver and balm of benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Nuit D'Issey Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HCDX5Q4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake Aftershave have added another amazing scent to their lineup. Nuit D'Issey is another winning fragrance from this brand. Developed by Master Perfumers Dominique Ropion and Loc Dong this fragrance stands out for it's distinctly masculine smell that evokes a night time feel with a refreshing pop. Nuit D'Issey is a lush, dark and manly fragrance that will leave your skin feeling refreshed and vibrant while you feel confident that you smell great too.  The citrus top notes of Grapefruit and Pepper add a distinct zing to the middle notes of Leather and Vanilla and they combine to give a refreshing feel on application and a manly fragrance that lasts all day. The base of Tonka bean and Patchouli give a traditional foundation which the other notes complement beautifully while presenting a more modern and unique scent. Presented in a classy and elegant brushed black bottle with solid black stopper, this will look perfect on your nightstand while the 125ml bottle is perfect for carrying in your bag or briefcase for use on the go.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Blue Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: This woody aromatic leathery fragrance boasts top notes of clary sage to strike a balance between freshness and refined texture. The tonic transparency of bergamot brings a breath of fresh air and contrasts with the spicy warmth of black pepper. The intense texture of leather reveals itself in the heart of the fragrance, assuming an extreme masculinity enhanced by the urban elegance of grey amber and the woody facets of cypress.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Fever will have you burning up from its alluring and seductive aroma. Others will find you inexplicably irresistible as they are drawn in by the sweet plum and fresh roses that dance with the lychee and subtle grapefruit. Your femininity will permeate the air with its jasmine, heliotrope, and vanilla orchid notes. Once someone is close to you, they cannot help but feel your sensuality cascade over them like a velvet drape, taking in the full aromatic essence of the benzoin, sandalwood, and tonka bean. With Jimmy Choo Fever perfume, the strong, independent woman can flaunt her seductive side and command her passions to do as she pleases. She will glide across the floor effortlessly, exuding glamour and sophistication. The Fever woman is mysterious, sexy, and untamable. Whether you want to keep them guessing or stand out in a crowded room, Jimmy Choo Fever 100ml is your signature scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum 40ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PAJYMWQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jimmy Choo perfume is world renowned and their latest addition, Fever, is no different. This 40ml spray is a seductive scent that can help every woman to channel their inner goddess. Discover the many elements of its notes and experience the excitement of the juicy sweet wintery persona of this amazing fragrance. As you apply the fragrance, you will be enveloped by the sweet scents of plum, lychee, and grapefruit. After the sweet scents fade a little, you can then indulge in the powdery floral scents of vanilla orchid, jasmine, and heliotrope. Allow the perfume to sit on your skin and prepare to be snuggled with the pleasant warmth of benzoin, tonka bean, and sandalwood scents that will accompany you through the night. Since the perfume is the brainchild of a designer who's well-known in the fashion world, there's much to be said about its chic bottle. It is packaged in a bottle that epitomizes beauty, class, and elegance which also embodies the intrinsic nature of a woman.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Essence Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WB9GH0U]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier le Male is best described as a bit of an avant-garde scent. If you are new to this exciting brand, you may know what to expect. This is certainly true of Le Male Essence de Parfum. After the first spray, you will probably find yourself mesmerised by the complexity of the scent. Le Male Jean Paul Gaultier offers a floral opening packed with iris and lavender. In many ways, if you have not tried the brand before, this offers the perfect introduction. Why do so many men like Boss? There are many reasons. However, the top reason is because it is a scent sensation. The scent is rich and musky. At the same time, it manages to offers softer undertones. That means that it is perfect for any time of the day or night. Aftershave for men are getting harder to find. It is nice to see that one of the world's leading fragrance brands is making a conscious effort to promote aftershaves. If you don't have anything from Hugo Boss in your fragrance collection, this aftershave offers you the perfect introductory opportunity.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Nomade Absolu de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=W42U23K]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Chloé Nomade perfume for her encapsulates the spirit of a woman open to the beauty of the World, who flourishes through her experiences and encounters. Nomade Absolu de Parfum is an invitation to a more intense getaway, immersed at the heart of a profoundly sophisticated fragrant luxuriance. With independence and elegance as her only baggage, the Nomade woman escapes once again. Free. Modern. Serene. The delicate, scented warmth of a fantasy destination. This woody chypre is a more intense version of the original composition. The oakmoss remains at the vibrant heart of Nomade, but here it reveals an unexpected refinement. The sumptuous texture of a sweet, Mirabelle plum brings a juicy dimension to the scent. A sensuousness enhanced by the fruity, aromatic inflections of velvety davana. A wind of liberty, warmed by the creamy, woody richness of soft sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=CJ0VTSL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Fun, fabulous and fearless, Very Good Girl is a bold new interpretation of the iconic Good Girl scent that will walk straight into your heart with its seductive rose scent and red-hot design. Evolving Carolina Herrera's vision of the duality of the modern woman, this sumptuous and surprising Eau de Parfum shows us that the multifaceted nature of contemporary femininity is where the true beauty of being a woman lies. Very Good Girl takes you on a surprising olfactive journey, starting with top notes of playfully mischievous redcurrant and exotic lychee, leading to a seductive heart of rose. Vetiver and vanilla base notes provide a surprising and contemporary finish.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal For Him Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IT25CCU]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal is a popular scent from the Gaultier team. As like so many other big brands, Jean Paul Gaultier are gearing up to meet with new environmental-friendly standards. The brand is one of the few brands that are taking refills seriously. If you already have a bottle of Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme in your collection, you should take advantage of this very special offer. This 200ml refill offers you the perfect opportunity to replace your scent. It is perfect to have on standby so that you never run out of your favourite Jean Paul Gaultier fragrance. As you probably know, Scandal is one of the most popular and exciting eau de toilette offerings from Jean Paul Gaultier. Don't miss out on this chance to stock up to make sure that you never run out. Needless to say, you will also be doing your bit to help the environment.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YG5UJUA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal is one of those scents you are not going to be able to live without once you have tried it. The scent was launched in 2021 and instantly became a hit. It will make you feel like a champion in no time at all. It is not only the fragrance which is different. The bottle is one of those scent bottles that you are not going to forget in a hurry. As with all other offerings from this exciting brand, the fragrance is what makes Scandal stand out. It is very aromatic with a sweet note of caramel and undertones of vanilla. As the scent develops, you can also enjoy notes of amber and citrus. Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme is a perfect choice no matter what age you are. It is an eau de toilette that never fails to please and always hits the right spot. Take the opportunity to try this 50ml bottle of this wonderful masculine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal For Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=JU51I4O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The new SCANDAL POUR HOMME by Jean Paul Gaultier. With muscled elegance and boxing gloves on, the new SCANDAL POUR HOMME by Jean Paul Gaultier makes a spectacular, hard-hitting entrance with a masculine eau de toilette that's sensual, energising and extremely addictive. Intoxicating the senses and crowned with victories, this king of the ring seduces his fans with a bang, leaving a masculine trail contrasted by an intense woody oriental fragrance in a refillable bottle. Keep your guard up: his eco-friendly and athletic charisma knocks out all his opponents. Paris trembles before him and asks for more: let the show begin! Set Includes: 100ml EDT + 75ml Shower Gel

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Set
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=BX6R6VL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} BAD BOY is a fragrant expression of duality, representing the bold nature of the modern man. At once strong and sensitive, confident and relaxed, the BAD BOY embraces his contrasting characteristics with assured ease. BAD BOY Eau de Toilette is a fragrance of layered notes inspired by the BAD BOY’s complexity and harmoniously combined for a distinctive blend of modern sophistication This gift set includes the fragrance in its 100ml bottle, as well as a 10ml travel spray and 100ml Shower Gel.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower L'Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=OX3154E]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Welcoming the bewitching power of the poppy, Fragrance Direct introduces Kenzo L'Elixir. A precious flower, with invaluable vitality. Its bloom conceals a vibrant sensuality, revealing the essence of women, their most captivating facet. FLOWERBYKENZO L'Elixir celebrates this femininity with a gourmand floral fragrance. The juicy Raspberry note and Bulgarian rose essence compose a deliciously chic alchemy, while the Bourbon Vanilla and Praline distil a sensual addiction. Fruity gourmand lead to luscious Raspberry and Mandarin opening notes. The heart is a precious floral blend of Bulgarian rose essence and Orange blossom, before coming to a close with an addictive sensual base of praline,

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold For Men Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PA3GE2B],#html-body [data-pb-style=SHDEAHK]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}#html-body [data-pb-style=SHDEAHK]{background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat} The One Gold fragrance celebrates a man who has a natural but unmistakable magnetism. A true gentleman, he exudes confidence with his innate elegance and unique style. The One Gold is the olfactory embodiment of this masculine charisma, a sophisticated woody, spicy, citrus Eau de Parfum Intense that is as powerfully alluring as the man who wears it. An invigorating fusion of juicy Italian bergamot and zesty bloody orange opens the fragrance, with red ginger adding a warm spiciness to the citrus top notes. The vibrant energy of these sparkling citruses evolves to a powerfully masculine heart of aromatic clary sage and crisp Egyptian geranium essence, enlivened by spicy notes of cardamom. Mysterious patchouli gives the perfume an intensely alluring base, its richness and subtle smokiness balanced by earthy Haitian vetiver and woody ambery notes.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GV0SN4S]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce & Gabbana presents The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense, the intense addition to the iconic The One Men fragrance family. The epitome of masculinity and elegance, the fragrance is charismatic and seductive, magnetic and sophisticated. This floriental fragrance features spicy notes of golden neroli essence and woody notes of cypress and aromatic cardamom. These are unexpectedly associated to rich base notes made from deep black leather, sweet patchouli and Mediterranean scents of cistus labdanum. The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense is encased in an elegant black bottle with gold touches to express its distinctive olfactory facets.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=GA1R6K9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce&Gabbana presents The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense, the intense addition to the iconic The One Men fragrance family.
