listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau D'Orange Verte Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=M23575M]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The original Hermès fragrance, Eau d’orange verte was originally created in 1979. Inspired by the intense freshness of lush undergrowth coated in morning dew, Eau d’orange verte provides a stand-out sunny fragrance that is well suited to man and woman alike. This unisex fragrance opens with an intense citrus blast of lemon and bergamot which invigorates the mind and body before softer floral notes of jasmine and orange blossom form the delicate, neutral body.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Tres Fraiche Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UR2WAC9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A fantastic fragrance created in 2006, Terre d’Hermès is for the man who is a poet by nature, someone who sees the extraordinary Terre d’Hermès in the ordinary. Terre d’Hermès contains many woody notes, including Atlas cedar. It is also a mix of grapefruit, effervescent orange, gunflint, silex, pepper, baies roses, geranium leaves, patchouli, vetiver, and balm of benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QKJXDVX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold Eau de Parfum for women will become your new addiction you simply won’t be willing to give up. It’s magic spell will enchant you from the first sniff and every new day will be a proof that you simply need to keep it on your vanity at all times.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Florabotanica Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QASA7HW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inspired by a strange and wonderful garden in which you do not know whether the flowers are innocent or poisonous, Florabotanica from Balenciaga evokes the 18th Century botanical gardens in which the most exotic and rarest plant species were displayed. Strange-coloured plants discovered in distant countries brought back from their travels by enthusiastic biologists. The vetiver, amber and caladium leaf accord create a resonance of mossy and mysterious dark wood, whilst the Experimental rose, carnation and mint accords add an exhilarating, freshness to the fragrance. To give Florabotanica its fairytale air, the perfumers added a formula of psychosensory plants, making it particularly enchanting.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Ultrared Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=PG8184J]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ultrared for woman by Paco Rabanne is an electrifying fragrance that dares to play with the contrast between the sparkling and ardent. A fruity burst of redcurrant and wild strawberries mixed with a festive floral heart of jasmine, star anis and marshmallow. The base of addictive cedar, amber and vanilla balances the sparkling fruity notes and gives a harmonic feel to this gorgeous fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Ultrared Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A1PHC26]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Ultra red is an ultra masculine fragrance bursting with energy, sensuality & passion. Ultrared has notes of blood orange, vanilla, & patchouli. This is further complemented with warm notes of praline & red thyme.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=DKQUNIJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Discover Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum for women, a fruity, joyful and irresistibly fresh floral fragrance by Dolce&Gabbana. First, be charmed by the colourful top notes of luscious mango contrasting with the zesty tartness of natural grapefruit essence. Then the heart of the scent blooms with a glorious swirl of airy jasmine accord mixed with a supple accord of sun-drenched blonde woods, which shine through this sunny fruity floral perfume. Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum will transport you to springtime on the Italian Amalfi Coast, when the first rays of sunlight trickle into the gardens at the beginning of the blooming season. This Mediterranean perfume is a new addition to the "Dolce" collection and comes in a delicate sunny yellow bottle with its Dolce&Gabbana signature handwritten name and the iconic bottle cap.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Bad Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FJH3WKF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lose yourself in the lavish aromas within the Diesel Bad Eau de Toilette. Seductive and alluring, the cologne opens with notes of tantalising Lime, Lavender and fiery Cardamom. Heady and captivating, the top notes mingle deliciously with a heart of opulent Caviar, offering an element of luxury to the cocktail. Brooding, smouldering visions are conjured with base notes of intoxicating Tobacco, Orris Root and hypnotic Woody Notes. Images of a dimly-lit bar are summoned, the hairs raising on the back of your neck as a tall, leather-clad figure approaches. Bad to the bone, the bottle is encased in a leather-look coating, making a rebellious statement wherever it is placed.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Summer (2021) Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SW98ETT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Inspired by a beautiful summer sunset, Calvin Klein Eternity Summer for Women evokes the alluring romance of the season in a sensual new floral fragrance. An uplifting and refreshing heart of anise star notes over a soft base of musk, and is topped with feminine desert rose oil—true to the natural scent of a desert rose. The balanced contrast between the floral and fluid notes is comparable to the blurred lines between water and sky, a perfect entity. Housed in a luminous coral bottle, the solar floral perfume scent exudes exotic allure. Luxuriantly feminine, the balanced fragrance is the quintessential fresh summer iteration of iconic ETERNITY.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Pin Up Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XDKTNIE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Classique was released in 2020 and immediately gained women's love for its unique and majestic scent. It is an aroma highlighted by a bouquet of warm, sensual, and classic scented tones that will not go unnoticed. With a deep gourmand and amber base, followed by floral center notes that blend majestically with pimento, this eau de parfum is perfect for bold, independent, and gracious women. Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Pin Up is designed with glitter inspiration in the most fashionable way. 100ml of this emblematic aroma is enough to give women a sense of power and sweetness at the same time. If you are a strong, classy, and funny woman, always ready to respond with spontaneity, not afraid of herself, and with a warm smile that will melt every man's heart out there, then Pin Up is the perfect aroma! Amber like a candy, sweet like a rose and soft like a gourmand, it awaits you to sample and see how well it blends with your character.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male In The Navy Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=S6NK3P7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male is one of those men's fragrances that you just have to have. If you have not as yet added it to your fragrance collection, this Le Male in The Navy offers you a chance to do so. When you look at the 200ml bottle, it immediately makes you think of Jean Paul Gaultier and his wonderful world of fragrances. The eau de toilette makes an amazing opening statement. You immediately know that you have a quality fragrance in your hands. As the scent develops, you will pick up many of its complex tones including a dark woody scent that is seductive but yet warming. As the fragrance is not overpowering at all, you can wear it any time of the day or night. It is never out of place and perfect for any occasion. Treat someone to a very special present or add it to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co Sheer Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KQKOTSD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Capture the luxury and romance of New York City with the Tiffany & Co. Sheer Eau de Toilette. This vibrant floral scent offers a bright and sparkling interpretation of the signature fragrance. Radiant notes of Black Currant, Vert de Mandarine and Ylang Ylang are elegantly blended with Rose Oil and finished with a luxurious Iris base. Composed by world-renowned Givaudan perfumer Daniela Andrier, this multifaceted fragrance structure is playful yet refined. Tiffany Sheer offers a subtle luxury for the skin, a pure expression of joy and love.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Gold Edition Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y11MNPB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The unisex Calvin Klein CK One Gold Eau de Toilette presents a youthful woody scent that combines the strength of both genders. The unisex CK One Gold fragrance came to life in 2016 and is the modern interpretation of the iconic CK One Eau de Toilette from 1994. Its motto is: “Be brave. Stand out from the crowd. Everything you touch exudes gold.” The energetic top notes consist of the unusual combination of fresh bergamot, juicy figs and slightly bitter sage. The heart of the composition is dominated by playful violet accords complemented by jasmine and tantalising neroli. The warm sensual conclusion will captivate you with guaiac wood and the essences of patchouli and woody vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss In Motion Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=A3NX7R5]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Aftershave editions offer some of the best fragrances for men in the world. Yet, it would seem that many men have still not discovered them. Whether you are already a fan of the brand or a newbie, you are going to love Boss in Motion. This is a fragrance for men that stands out and truly delivers when it comes to scent quality. What can you expect from Hugo Boss in Motion? The first notes are packed with the rich aroma of warm spice and woody top notes. Take the time and let the scent develop and you will soon encounter citrus and cinnamon. A deep dark musky note will also drift buy. Thanks to its many nuances, the fragrance is perfect for any time of the day or night. The 100ml eau de toilette bottle is stylish and never looks out of place. It has to be said that the fragrance makes a fantastic personal purchase as well as a gift idea.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Man Extreme Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F5N1JKY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Aftershave is a brand that knows a lot about men's fragrances. The brand boosts many exciting scents. One of the most exciting offerings from the brand is Hugo Boss Man Extreme. This scent is capable of bursting through the air. At the same time, you have to say that it can linger as well. When you are looking for a fragrance that is more complexed and has more to offer, you are looking for Hugo Boss Man. The fragrance makes a bold opening statement with spice and a cloud of aroma. After that, it settles down and delivers a coolness and freshness which are both hard to match. It is the perfect scent for any time of the day or night. When you don't have an eau de parfum from the brand on your bathroom shelf, now is the perfect time to add one. We are delighted to be able to offer this 75ml bottle that makes a great personal purchase or gift for that special man in your life.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YS2VDCR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty is an ageless classic. The sexy, warm, floral essence has led to the popularity of this scent. The opening notes of this fragrance are an airy veil of sweet flowers combined with delicious berries, fresh peaches, and crisp bergamot. The middle notes include sweet peony, subtle lily, and sensual jasmine. The base consists of deep woodsy sandalwood, earthy musk, and rich vanilla blossom.   The sweet floral-fruity bouquet mixed with the richness of vanilla makes it a great fragrance for everyday wear. The warm sexy ora of citrusy bergamot, rich jasmine, and sandalwood make it a perfect Eau de Toilette for evening wear. The addition of musk leads to the longevity of the smell so that you have to reapply less often. The combination of all of these luscious scents makes Sheer Beauty Calvin Klein 100ml an excellent choice for every occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>Azzaro Wanted is looking for you, the sophisticated man ready to take on the world. It wants you, the charismatic Don Juan, who lives life on the edge. Let the Wanted aftershave arouse that which you crave.</p> <p>This bold fragrance gets driven by spicy, citrus, and woody notes, radiating a desire for the man who wears it. Dare to be invincible with Azzaro Wanted 100ml.</p> <p>Even the bottle drips with masculine sex appeal with its metallic contours that scream your name. Its unique shape begs for you to rip its cap off and basque in its aromatic luxury.</p>

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Introducing Azzaro 'Wanted' an audacious and flamboyant new fragrance for men. It is a woody, citrus and spicy eau de toilette with a fresh, sensual and captivating masculinity. Its sensual woody notes establish a new elegant and captivating masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray

Top notes are caraway, orris, lavender, clary sage, basil, anise, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are sandalwood, juniper berries, patchouli, vetiver, cedar and cardamom; base notes are leather, tonka bean, amber, musk and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro pour Homme by Azzaro is a aromatic fougere fragrance for men. Azzaro pour Homme was launched in 1978. listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2007 Chrome Legend is a follow-up to 1996's Chrome, and is described as 'a more sophisticated fragrance'.The notes include tea, green apple, bitter orange, musk, moss, sea spray, cedar, vetiver, amber and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

The heart develops notes of ozone, jasmine water and lichen, while the base is created of precious wood, mate, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Built on a dominant citrus and musk accord, the fragrance arouses freshness and vigor. A gentle aquatic note is added to this opening aroma, followed by a woody end note mixed with shades of 'tea'. Top note: Lemon, Petitgrain, Rosemary, Pineapple. Middle note : Coriander, Jasmine, Cyclamen, Orris. Base note : Cedarwood, Moss, Tonka, Musk. listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Is inspired by the Style and charm of the Italian man, this masculine fragrance opens with top notes of Neroli, Mandarin and Bergamot. Middle notes of Sage and Pepper are followed by base notes of Tobacco, Cedar wood and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso is an aromatic, woody fragrance. Intenso opens with bright Aquatic notes and accents of Basil blended with Marigold and Geranium, the middle notes are made up of Lavender, Tobacco, Hay and Bran. Base notes finish the fragrance with accents of Balsamic and Honey along with Labdanum, Sandalwood and Cypress.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Pour Femme Intense is an oriental, floral fragrance with a high intensity. This fragrance opens with top notes of Neroli and green mandarin. Middle notes Orange Blossom and Tuberose create a strong feminine scent, base notes of Guimauve, Sandalwood and Musk give a seductively sensual end to this fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Essence de Parfum 65ml Spray
listings.description: The One Essence is an oriental, floral fragrance with the highest concentration of Dolce & Gabbana's The One range. The fragrance opens with fresh top notes of Bergamot, Mandarin, Peach and Lychee, middle notes bloom with White Flowers, Jasmine and Lily of the Valley. The scent closes with a warm base of Amber and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Eau de Parfum 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HFMSW6N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Delving into a deeper, more refined scent for the connoisseur of fragrance, Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum reveals a denser, more intense re-imagining of the original Eau de Toilette. Conquering a definitively charismatic masculinity, The One for Men embodies a perfect reflection of the Dolce & Gabbana man, sophisticated and bold with a seductive charm.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Desire Blue Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Dunhill Desire Blue is an aquatic, ambery fragrance that begins on a top note of bergamot, tangerine and lotus. Its middle note of sea breeze accord, orange flower water, rosewood and driftwood blends to a bottom note of amber crystals and rich musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Desire Red For Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Dunhill in 1997, Desire is a refreshing, oriental and woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of warm and sensual blend of fruits and wood, with low notes of vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Desire For Men Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Dunhill in 1997, Desire is a refreshing, oriental and woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of warm and sensual blend of fruits and wood, with low notes of vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Icon Absolute For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2015 this woody spicy fragrance opens with top notes of bergamot and black pepper; middle notes are saffron, black rose and jasmine; base notes are agarwood, tobacco leaf and leather.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Icon Elite For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Celebrating the elegant man and his timeless style. Dunhill's Icon Elite is woody and very masculine. Vetiver, sandalwood and abonos wood are harmoniously blended with sweet cardamom, encapsulating the deep sensuality and boundless depths of iconic men.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Icon For Men Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Dunhill Icon is a true masculine fragrance in every way. Not only does Icon deliver as far as the scent is concerned. The design and shape of the 100ml bottle portray masculinity as well. It is perhaps why so many men buy this perfume and include it in their arsenal of fragrances. The eau de parfum has early notes of neroli and bergamot. As the scent continues to develop, you will also pick up pepper, cardamon and a hint of lavender. The finishing touch is of vetiver and oak moss. It is one of the true masculine scents on the market. It has to be said that this is a very indulgent perfume. Perfect to wear when going out for the night. It is a lovely gift to buy for the man in your life. It is also a great scent to buy yourself if you are looking to stand out from the crowd.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Desire Black for Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Desire Black was launched in 2014. the opening scents are black pepper, bergamot and grapefruit; middle notes are saffron, cypress and rose. Laying on a base of vetiver, olibanum and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Dunhill Desire Blue For Men Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: Dunhill Desire Blue is an aquatic, ambery fragrance that begins on a top note of bergamot, tangerine and lotus. Its middle note of sea breeze accord, orange flower water, rosewood and driftwood blends to a bottom note of amber crystals and rich musk.

listings.rawTitle: Ed Hardy For Women Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Introducing the vintage tattoo-inspired fragrance sensation, Ed Hardy by Christian Audigier. A color explosion of fruits opens the scent including tropical mango, wild strawberry and ruby red grapefruit. Vintage floralcy with a rock ‘n' roll edge brings a dark sexiness including black freesia. This contrast of floralcy merges into a background of hot skin musk and warm soulful amber. It is a delicious and very addictive fragrance statement.

listings.rawTitle: Ed Hardy Hearts and Daggers for Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: After two successful fragrant pairs from the collection Ed Hardy, Christian Audigier presents his third pair inspired by hearts and daggers in tattoo form. The collection includes fragrances Ed Hardy Hearts & Daggers for Her and Ed Hardy Hearts & Daggers for Him which arrived on the market in November 2009.

listings.rawTitle: Ed Hardy Hearts and Daggers for Women Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Christian Audigier Ed Hardy Hearts & Daggers for Her eau de parfum is an unbridled fragrance for energetic women who are not afraid of experiments and like trying new things. Jasmine and amber underline the notes of fresh fruit and encourage you to feel unbridled and free. You will feel like a rock star with Christian Audigier Ed Hardy Hearts & Daggers for Her – so energetic, free and irresistibly sexy.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Radiant, voluptuous, addictive. The top note opens on a sun-kissed, radiant orange blossom, as an ode to light. The middle note develops into a jasmine absolute, a legendary flower in perfumery, imparting voluptuousness and elegance to the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Radiant, voluptuous, addictive. The top note opens on a sun-kissed, radiant orange blossom, as an ode to light. The middle note develops into a jasmine absolute, a legendary flower in perfumery, imparting voluptuousness and elegance to the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense fragrance is announced as ultra sensual and feminine. The scent of orange blossom and rose honey are what make the signature of the Elie Saab perfume line. This oriental-floral composition opens with bright orange blossom accord. The heart includes intoxicating and opulent flower of ylang-ylang mixed with rose honey. The base consists of patchouli and amber accord.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le parfum Rose Couture Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The composition of this beautiful fragrance begins with a combination of orange blossom, silky rose petals and peony. The heart continues with accords of rose nectar, fruity nuances, jasmine and vanilla. The base is a woody accord of patchouli and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: Radiant, voluptuous, addictive. The top note opens on a sun-kissed, radiant orange blossom, as an ode to light. The middle note develops into a jasmine absolute, a legendary flower in perfumery, imparting voluptuousness and elegance to the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl of Now Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=V3870IE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The spirit of the Girl of Now in a fragrance. A distinctive gourmand floral Eau de Parfum: an addictive note of Almond, textured with Orange Blossom and Patchouli, the brand's signature. Inspired by Lebanese delights, the fragrance opens with Roasted Pistachio and sparkling Pear for an addictive top. In the heart, Essence of Bitter Almond and Orange Blossom Absolute assembled together create a new exclusive note the Ormon Flower, which reveals precious and gourmand facets. Tonka Bean and Almond Milk blended together leave a final Almond trail while Patchouli reinforces the ultimate Elie Saab.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Intense Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense fragrance is announced as ultra sensual and feminine. The scent of orange blossom and rose honey are what make the signature of the Elie Saab perfume line. This oriental-floral composition opens with bright orange blossom accord. The heart includes intoxicating and opulent flower of ylang-ylang mixed with rose honey. The base consists of patchouli and amber accord.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Rose Couture Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: The composition of this beautiful fragrance begins with a combination of orange blossom, silky rose petals and peony. The heart continues with accords of rose nectar, fruity nuances, jasmine and vanilla. The base is a woody accord of patchouli and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=URWIS0L]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Elizabeth Arden 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and classic fragrance that captures the energy and sophistication of New York. This elegant scent opens with lilac, linden blossom, magnolia, muguet, mandarin, and bergamot, creating a vibrant and stylish aroma. The heart reveals a floral blend of Bulgarian rose, ylang-ylang, tuberose, jasmine, violet, and a hint of peach, clove, and nutmeg. The base notes of vanilla, amber, iris, sandalwood, and musk leave a warm, sensual trail. Launched in 1996, this floral fragrance embodies confidence and grace. Fragrance Family: Floral Key Notes: Top: Lilac, Linden Blossom, Magnolia, Muguet, Mandarin, Bergamot Middle: Violet, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Bulgarian Rose, Tuberose, Peach, Clove, Nutmeg Base: Vanilla, Amber, Iris, Sandalwood, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Beauty Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Elizabeth Arden in 2002. Beauty is a refreshing, crystalline, oriental, woody fragrance suitable for office wear and every day occasions. Top notes of iris, bergamot, and rice flower. Middle notes of orchid, ginger, rhubarb, lotus and lily. Base notes of sandalwood, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A light fragrance for casual wear that combines melon, peach, rose and moss scents. A bright, light-hearted, happy celebration of the simplicity and joy of summer. Top notes of bergamot, melon and peach. Middle notes of jasmine and cyclamen and base notes of sandalwood and moss create this energizing fragrance. The sunflower represents strength, beauty, health and intuitive.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden True Love Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1994, True Love is a refreshing, gentle, floral fragrance recommended for romantic occasions. This feminine aroma contains a blend of jasmine, lotus, iris and is accented with narcisse, sandalwood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Untold Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A luxurious and modern rendition of a sensuous floral composition, Elizabeth Arden Untold Eau de Parfum celebrates the sophistication and intrigue of the multi-faceted modern woman. From her vibrant optimism to her refined femininity, mysterious aura and magnetic sensuality, Untold takes you on a journey through the many facets of a woman that together, make her genuinely beautiful. A sparkling and fruity introduction, a radiant floral heart and a mysterious addictive warmth, this fragrance captures all that a woman is. Top Notes: Black Currant, Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Pear. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Peony, Jasmine and base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli Heart, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Red Door Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: This elegant, sensuous blend of deep, rich florals features a captivating scent that fills the senses. Top notes of ylang ylang, rose and fruity nuances merge with middle notes of rare oriental orchid, jasmine, lily of the valley, Moroccan orange flowers, forest lilies, freesia, carnation and a touch of wild violets. The romantic final notes leave a sensual impression of oakmoss, sandalwood, vetiver, a hint of honey and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Sapphires Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Taylor in 1993, Diamonds & Sapphires is a refreshing, flowery fragrance. This aroma blends lily of the valley, rose, ylang- ylang, spices, jasmine and a fresh floral bouquet.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Passion For Him Eau de Cologne 118ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Taylor in 1989, Passion for Men is a refined, oriental, woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of ginger, clove oil, nutmeg, jasmine and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: White Diamonds, launched in 1991, has top notes of neroli, lily and tuberose, middle notes of orris and amber and base notes of sandalwood, patchouli and oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Agua Del Sol Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Introduced in 2016, this sweet floral fruity fragrance begins with sweet and sharp, icy raspberry sorbet combines with nashi pear granita to create mouth-watering top notes; touches of energizing pink peppercorn bring a pop of spice to the fragrance; and the warm and sensual combination of tonka bean, sandalwood and white musk cream forms a comforting blend.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Island Kiss Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Escada Island Kiss is a fragrance inspired by Caribbean beaches, fragrant coasts, salty air and lush notes of fruit and flower. Top notes include orange, passion flower and mango highlighting that this is an exotic edition refreshed with aquatic, juicy and fruity peach notes combined with magnolia in the heart. The base adds woody notes and sensual musk.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Elixir Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Especially Escada Elixir is a powerful interpretation of the rose fragrance that is Especially Escada. Unlike its first re-adaptation, Especially Escada Delicate Notes, the Especially Elixir fragrance represents its intense version. This fragrance stands for boldly elegant women, who radiates confidence and brightens the room with her energy and smile.This mysterious rose scent begins with pear, ambrette seed and grapefruit. The heart includes Turkish rose absolut, ylang-ylang, accords of prune and fresh plums, laid on a base of patchouli, white musk, dry amber, cashmere and Madagascar

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Delicate Notes Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Especially Escada Delicate Notes by Escada. This is a fresh and floral fragrance for women. It contains of wild rose, grapefruit, pear, rose, ylang-ylang, ambrette seed, musk and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The luxurious combination of rose and Ylang radiate a fresh and natural aura of positivity; the uplifting ingredients synonymous with joy and happiness.Light musky notes to support the delicate floral bouquet complete the scent adding a subtle touch of femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Pi Neo Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A visionary man who ventures from the real world into a virtual world, a man about to enter the fourth dimension.The Pi Neo hero is thirsty for knowledge.He defies the time-space equation, on a quest for a new dimension where everything is possible, setting out to conquer new space, where reality and virtuality merge to infinity.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HS06YEX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Choose to live a spontaneous life with the Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette, an alluring floral fragrance for women. Even more endearing than her magical smile, this flirtatious scent was made for a provocative woman. When you're touched by her presence, she's hard to resist. Her eyes sparkle with spontaneity, whilst her signature scent lingers with delight. Similar to its wearer, this playful fragrance exudes innocence, charm and complete irresistibility. Blended with the beauty of five delicate roses, a dominate burst of flower power storms open the scent. Accentuated by sparkling verbena, the elegant core of centifolia and peony rose toy with the velvet petals of passion and fantasia rose, creating an elegant affair for all to enjoy. Notes: Star Anise, Verbena Leaf, Centifolia Rose, Peony Rose, Passion Rose, Fantasia Rose, Emotion Rose

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Xeryus Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Xeryus by Givenchy is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Xeryus was launched in 1986. Top notes are lavender, green notes, mandarin orange, violet, jasmine, nutmeg flower, ylang-ylang, lily-of-the-valley, bergamot, rose and lemon; middle notes are cyclamen, coriander, carnation, cypress, sandalwood, juniper berries, cinnamon, tarragon, petitgrain and geranium; base notes are leather, amber, musk, oakmoss, balsam fir, vetiver, incense and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ysatis Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Givenchy in 1985, Ysatis is an elegant, soft, woody fragrance. This feminine scent contains a blend of mandarin, oak moss, rose, iris, vanilla, clove and amber and is suitable for daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NOO5153]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sensual, indulgent fragrance featuring a special twist: a floral quintet of five elegant roses interpose a spicy head of anise and a comforting base of vanilla and patchouli. This enchanting fragrance offers a rich sampling of roses along a trail of freshness and soft spice.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentlemen Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T5MWJYM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} If you’re a fan of the GIVENCHY Gentleman collection, you’re bound to love this latest addition. The Intense Eau de Toilette possesses all of the artisanal qualities of a true Gentleman fragrance; it’s both refined and classic. For fans of the original, you’ll recognise the iconic bottle design, which has been coloured in a black-to-blue ombre that shows the contrast of sweet blue iris and woods inside this scent. What makes this addition different to the GIVENCHY Gentleman Eau de Parfum? You can expect a green, fresher signature!

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Live Irresistible Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Your mood- Happy and Irrésistible. Your motto- Join my happiness! Your fragrance- A floral and fruity cocktail, sparkling and juicy. Seize the moment, share your happiness and rewrite all the rules, leaving just one: Live Irrésistible.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Play Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Contemporary yet timeless, the Givenchy Play Intense Eau De Toilette is what a man will love to sport for casual outings. Infused with a rich texture, character and warmth, this 2008 launch will give a boost to your confidence. The top notes concentrate on Mandarin and Bergamot to rejuvenate your senses. Coffee Wood, Pink Pepper and Amyris Wood compose the fluttering heart and give it a sensuous tone. The trail of Tonka Bean, Vetiver and Patchouli shows off a woody-oriental hint and the confidence is evident in his stride.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Xeryus Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y25LMU1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Warm and intense, Xeryus Rouge is a classic, Woody Amber designed for a man who embraces his freedom and is a risk-taker at heart. His fiery, intuitive sensuality is irresistibly captivating with an underlying mystery that cannot be resisted. Succulent kumquat and green cactus are dusted with red pepper and crushed cedar wood for a seductive scent that lingers. Woody Amber Top Notes: Kumquat, Green Cactus Heart Note: Red Pepper Base Note: Cedar Wood

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E58V0YF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A woody-aromatic scent, rich with spice notes, mingled with Russian leather, it makes a statement. The fragrance combines vigour and character, thanks to the alliance of vetiver, tarragon and cinnamon. The inspiration is a confident, contemporary and determined man, who represents timeless, masculine seduction. Givenchy Gentleman is a modern man, elegant and proud of his appearance.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Insense Ultramarine Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Givenchy Insense Ultramarine is a tart aromatic fragrance designed in 1994. It has notes of citrus, bergamot, mint cardamom, cedar, tobacco and musk. For the distinctive and modern man.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Play Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Modern and contemporary, Play by Givenchy is presented in a bottle shaped like an MP3 player. Givenchy Play will include notes of bitter orange, grapefruit, black pepper and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Organza Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1996, this floral, oriental, woody fragrance combines the freshness of sap, honeysuckle and rosewood with the voluptuousness of gardenias, poppies and tuberoses and the intensity and timelessness of amber and nutmeg.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Bamboo by Gucci is a floral fragrance for women. It contains notes of bergamot, Ylang-Ylang, Casablanca lily, orange blossom, sandalwood, Tahitian vanilla and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Delightfully feminine, but deceptively powerful. Bamboo by Gucci is a stylish modern fragrance exhibiting exotic floral notes brewed with deep, rich woods. Created especially for the woman of many faces; sophisticated, intense but gentle all at once.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci by Gucci Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci By Gucci. This is a fresh and floral fragrance for women. It contains of guava, raspberry, pear, chamomile, Tahitian Tiare flower, orange blossom, spider lily, patchouli, honey and musky notes.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Envy Me Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: A playful fruity floral fragrance inspired by the experience of feeling irresistible. Gucci Envy Me is a playful fruity floral fragrance that is inspired by that delightful experience of feeling irresistible, of being desired. Watch me, want me, envy me.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Flora by Gucci is a subtle and sophisticated floral scent. Built on a fresh and feminine breeze of flowers (Rose, Osmanthus), the fragrance top note conveys the freshness and lightness of citrus fruits.Fresh and feminine, the fragrance remains very Gucci, with a sensual and subtly powerful base note of sandalwood and pink pepper.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Flora by Gucci is a subtle and sophisticated floral scent. listings.description: The male counterpart of the women's fragrance line, Gucci By Gucci Pour Homme is for the successful man who has a charismatic, intense presence. listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=FSAVWIV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guilty Black Pour Femme by Gucci. listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: A scent of defiance, the wearer of Gucci Guilty is the architect of her own destiny. listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Can't get enough couture? Well here's even more, for Juicy girls who want it all. listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Peace Love & Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

Base notes: caramel crème brulee, vanilla, precious woods and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture I Am Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Justin Bieber Next Girlfriend Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray

listings.description: A floral fruity fragrance said to be mood-lifting, authentic and warm, it opens with pineapple, raspberry leaf and mandarin, heart notes of woody, powdery orris root, jasmine and rose, and a base of coconut, sandalwood, and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Pour Elle Elegant Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2015 as a part of the L.12.12 Pour Elle collection, it is announced as a classic scent for a confident woman, always fresh and relevant. This floral woody musk fragrance begins with notes of citrus oils, cassis buds, and pink pepper; blending with mimosa, violet, and lily of the valley; and base notes of vetiver, vanilla, and heliotrope.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste L 12 12 Rouge eau de toilette spray for men is described as a fresh and spicy perfume, opening with top notes of Mandarin, Mango and Tea, flowing into a heart of Black Pepper, Ginger and Cardamom, all of which sits on top of a smooth base of Acacia, Benzoin and Rockrose.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L.12.12. Blanc is a pure classic floral woody fragrance. Top notes are grapefruit, cardamom, rosemary and cedar leaf, mixed with the core of Mexican tuberose and ylang-ylang. Sensual notes of leather, suede and cedar form the base.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Jaune Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L.12.12. Jaune is a scent that triggers optimism, joy and positive energy. The inventiveness and elegance of the Lacoste polo shirt revisited in a fragrance. A light and energizing fragrance to make you feel optimistic with the first rays of sunshine.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Challenge Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste Challenge opens with fresh and energetic notes of tangerine and lemon, augmented by a burst of lavender. The middle accord is driven by spices including ginger, while the powerful base notes of rosewood and teak bring a modern edge and reinforces the heritage of the brand.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Energized Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Celebrate your passion for the game with the new Eau de Lacoste Energized Edition! Lacoste has spiced up their iconic Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc with an edgy note of excitement. The original has been spiced up in the top with fiery ginger and a hint of cool mint to enhance the scent’s energetic freshness. The signature tuberose heart of Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc remains untouched but is shaped in the base by masculine leathery and cedar wood notes.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Live Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A dynamic fragrance with an energetic composition. It reflects the fashion statement of Lacoste with its legendary short sleeves polo shirt. Fragrance Family: Green Notes Top Notes: Lime Heart Notes: Green leaves, Aquatic notes Base Notes: Gaiac wood, Licorice, Iris.

listings.rawTitle: Lady Gaga Fame Black Fluid Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Lady Gaga Fame is the first perfume to be endorsed by singer Lady Gaga. Released through the singer's Haus Laboratories label in association with Coty, Inc. The perfume utilizes a "push-pull technology", rather than a pyramidal structure, to bring out its notes of Atropa belladonna, Tiger Orchid, incense, apricot, saffron, and honey. It is stated to be the first black-colored perfume to spray clear and turn invisible once airborne.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Tresor In Love Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Lancome Tresor in Love captures the spirit of the first moment of love. Nectarine accord and bergamot enchant with a radiant burst of youth. Turkish rose essence and jasmine reveal your feminine side. Cedarwood and musk creates a warm, modern effect.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Poeme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1995, this scent is unusual in that it is based on a single floral bouquet of blue poppy, mimosa, jonquil, freesia, rose, and vanilla rather than the more common multi-layered composition of most fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Vetyver Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Hubert de Givenchy’s personal bespoke fragrance, Vétyver was later offered as a distinguished Couture masculine scent in Givenchy’s flagship stores across the fashion capitals.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Electric Rose Eau De Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Very Irresistible Givenchy Electric Rose is announced as an aromatic - floral fragrance inspired by the raw rock 'n' roll music. The fragrance reflects rebellious style and unusual elegance signature to this house. The composition begins with very bright and fresh notes of blueberry, lemon, basil and verbena. The heart is expectedly dominated by rose, mixed with notes of anise and dewy green violet. The base accords include cedar wood and pearly musk.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Essence Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=SXW2RIY]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Gucci Guilty Essence Eau de Toilette for Men invites you on a journey of self-expression, creativity, and authenticity. Celebrating individuality, friendship, and love in all its forms, this distinctive fragrance offers a modern twist on the classic aromatic Fougère. It’s a scent designed for those who embrace their true selves with confidence and style. Opening with the clean, captivating scent of Lavender, the fragrance then transitions into a heart of Orange Blossom. Traditionally associated with feminine perfumes, this floral note adds a touch of bold romanticism, reflecting Gucci’s non-traditional approach to perfumery. Finally, Patchouli, a signature element of the Gucci fragrance line, grounds the scent with warm, earthy richness that lingers. Encased in a bottle that blends matte black with deep green glass—a nod to Gucci’s iconic stripe—the design reflects the duality of strength and sensitivity. The iconic interlocking Gs serve as a gateway to this luxurious fragrance, symbolising a deeper connection to oneself through scent. Gucci Guilty Essence is more than a cologne; it’s a statement of self-acceptance and bold individuality.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty EAU Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Guilty Eau by Gucci is a floral fruity fragrance for women. It contains watery notes, litchi, lily, wild strawberry and musk. Guilty Eau by Gucci was launched in 2015.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Made to Measure Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: This is a masculine, oriental and spicy scent which opens with notes of bergamot and lavender and anise. The heart contains nutmeg, juniper berry, while the base notes follows with notes of cistus labdanum, patchouli and dark hints of leather.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau D'Orange Verte Concentre Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Concentre D'Orange Verte is a deeper, more vivid, interpretation on the original Eau D'Orange Verte fragrance. Provide a lasting well of freshness, Concentre D'Orange Verte excites a mass of crisp citrus fragrance founding itself strongly in sweet, sunny and succulent orange. This is then backed in a peppering of basil and patchouli that eventually sinks into a steady base of amber and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Hugo Woman Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The 1990s was very kind to us. We got The Lion King, Friends and the Spice Girls. For the younger folk, we even got the Internet itself - making this fine website and cracking Hugo Boss offer possible. The nineties also gave us Hugo Boss Woman Eau de Parfum. A classic fragrance that woman all over the world have relied on for years to give them a modern, feminine and sensual scent. Boss Woman begins with fruity top notes of orange, mandarin and apple which is blended with freesia, and finished with sandalwood, vanilla, cedarwood, orris and musk. It might not be the most memorable release of the 90s, but it's survived and that's testament to strength of the Hugo Boss brand and this incredbily stylish perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Nuit Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=K63L6J3]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss perfume embodies a sexy and feminine fragrance that lingers on the body for hours. The creation of the perfume was inspired by little black dress and is designed to radiate a soft, mysterious, sweet, and distinctive smell coupled with a good silage. Starting from the top, the notes of the Hugo Boss Nuit Pour Femme consist of ingredients like peach and aldehyde, which gives the perfume its good performance. Together with a fresh, elegant and fruity flavor, this perfume really stands out from the crowd. In the heart note is a blend of white flower, violet and jasmine, which gives the perfume its sensual vibe. The base note constitutes creamy sandalwood and crystalline moss, giving the spray its sophisticated and exotic tang. The Hugo Boss Nuit Eau de Parfum 50ml spray is designed for the smart, sexy, and modern woman who wants to keep a low profile while ensuring that she smells good throughout the night.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Jour Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: As a contrast to Boss Nuit Pour Femme, the house of Hugo Boss has launched Boss Jour Pour Femme, with a milky white flacon, shaped like Nuit. This fragrance shows the three faces of a woman: inspiration, composure and ease, described with a beautiful blend of white flowers chilled with sparkling citrus. Lightness and freshness are presented with a combination of accented accords of lime and grapefruit blossom representing the liveliness of the first morning rays of light that radiate with positive anticipation. Inspiration is retold with a rich bouquet of white flowers, including flowers of freesia, lily of the valley and honeysuckle celebrating the femininity and beautiful diversity of life of every woman.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pure Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KVOVSPP]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume never fails to delight. You will know this if you are already a fan or follower of this exclusive perfumer. One of its outstanding fragrances is Issey Miyake l'eau d'Issey Pure. This fragrance is a delight for the senses. It has a presence and a softness that makes it instantly recognisable. If you have not as yet tried it, now you have an opportunity to do so. What can you expect when you open a bottle of l'eau d'Issey Pure? The fragrance is beautiful in its simplicity. The first notes are of embracing amber and marine waves. Once the first wave of delight has washed over you, aromatic notes will make their presence felt. We have to admit that we are delighted to have Pure available as a special offer. The eau de toilette is perfect for wearing at anytime and anywhere. It is one of those fragrances that never fails to delight. Purchase it for yourself or give it away as a very special gift.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pure Nectar Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HHJN9MD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume have added another gorgeous light scent to their collection. People do not only describe this spray as floral. It also has strong woodsy notes. Subtle aquatic notes round out the fragrance as well. A delicate and feminine pear scent kicks off this perfume. The foundation of the fragrance, though, lies in the rose aroma. The rose scent includes a touch of honey. The core of this Issey Miyake spray includes strong notes of the previously mentioned cashmeran, ambergris and sandalwood. Dominique Ropion and Fanny Bal are the two creators of this fragrance. The Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pure Nectar is an eau de parfum that features prominent notes of flowers. L'eau D'issey Pure Nectar is equipped with top notes such as bergamot, pear and honey. Its middle notes are peony, rose and water. The base notes, last but not least, are ambergris, violet, white musk, cashmeran and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Refillable Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=IOFXW5P]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume have added another gorgeous perfume to thier collection. This L'eau D'issey is a pretty smell that comes in a 75ml spray bottle that you can refill when you need to. This is the perfect size to put into your handbag and the L'eau D'issey is one of the most popular aromas from the popular perfume brand. There are some gorgeous notes to this eau de parfum, namely vanilla and rose petals. If you are looking for a new floral smell and want to try something a little different, the Issey Miyake Leau Dissey smells beautiful and would be appropriate for a bunch of different occasions. The size means it is easy to carry around and it also won't take up too much space in your bathroom cabinet, it comes in pretty packaging too. You are guaranteed to get plenty of compliments when you have the Issey Miyake women on your skin so what are you waiting for?

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Launched in 1993 this is a fresh yet warm, woody scent accented with spicy notes. It has top notes of juniper, bergamot and lavender, middle notes of sage, coriander and freesia and base notes of sandalwood, moss and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Katy Perry Purr Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The composition of Katy Perry Purr is developed by Firmenich perfumer house, combining top notes of peach, forbidden apple, gardenia and green bamboo with the heart of jasmine, pink freesia and Bulgarian rose and the base of vanilla orchid, creamy sandalwood, white amber, coconut and musk. The image of the bottle is in the form of a cat with eyes like jewels, coloured in metallic shades of lavender.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros is the definition of masculinity, featuring a dynamic and powerful drive of animalic scents it envisions and empowers the idea of perfectly sculpted machismo. Opening in a fiery breath of spice the fragrance starts in coriander and clary sage before stepping into a bright heart of cinnamon, carnations and jasmine. Finally the fragrance unleashes a rich bestial bed of animalic civet, leather and oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y9PRSAA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume is one of the best perfume brands in the world today. The team behind the brand's range of fragrances are always creating new feminine scents. One of the best scents from this top-class perfumer is Daisy Marc Jacobs Eau So Fresh. The fragrance offers you the perfect blend of freshness and a more daring bouquet. The fragrance delights you with its fresh notes of citrus and violets. At the same time, there are other deeper notes that develop as you let the scent linger. This makes Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh perfect for wearing any time of the day or night. We are offering this unique scent in a 75ml bottle. The bottle is a piece of art in its own right. Treat yourself to this amazing fragrance or buy it for a friend. It a feminine scent that never fails to please and is one of the flagship fragrances from the brand.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb in Bloom Eau De Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Flowerbomb has been the iconic first fragrance from Viktor&Rolf for over 10 years. Now, Viktor&Rolf continue to surprise with the next chapter of the Flowerbomb story: New Flowerbomb Bloom. Bursting with freshness as a fruity floriental, the new Eau de Toilette has juicy top notes with a burst of pomegranate accord, bergamot and mandarin oils. In the heart, Flowerbomb Bloom continues the iconic Flowerbomb floral bouquet containing Centifolia Rose, Sambac Jasmin, India Osmanthus and Cattleya Orchid, but with new added pure air molecules. The base is strong and memorable with musk, vanilla and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Subtly rebellious and nonchalant, Valentino Uomo is a synthesis of contrasts and timeless modernity. A profoundly and unique Italian refined blend made of precisely chosen ingredients. Enveloped by the limpid elegance of zesty bergamot and its surprising hint of spice. Barely touched by myrtle, it opens with racy notes of coffee and the shimmering tones of gianduja cream, in a memorable enticing duo. It is retained by an enveloping musky hint of white leather that reveals the majesty of cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Muse Eau de Parfum 30ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2016 in a bottle described as a "cosmic pebble", this oriental vanilla fragrance begins its composition with top notes of grapefruit and pink pepper; heart notes of rose, hazelnut, and whipped cream and a base of vetiver and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Innocent Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Angel Innocent by Thierry Mugler is a refreshing, flowery scent. A blend of pure mandarin, honey, fresh almond and several other exotic fruits is mixed with the soothing notes of musk and amber. Angel Innocent is a perfect perfume for feminine women.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Edition Passion Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Angel Passion Star by Thierry Mugler is an oriental vanilla fragrance for women. It contains notes of melon, coconut, mandarin orange, cassis, jasmine, bergamot, cotton candy, honey, apricot, blackberry, plum, orchid, peach, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, red berries, rose, tonka bean, amber, patchouli, musk, vanilla, chocolate and caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Eau Sucree Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The fragrance opens with juicy, tangy and frosted red berries sorbet. The heart includes a new gourmand accord of caramelised meringue cream. The final touch is oriental and sensual thanks to notes of patchouli and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Angel Eau de parfum 25ml Gift Set
listings.description: Angel, released by Thierry Mugler in 1992, is a refreshing, oriental, woody scent recommended for daytime wear. It explores essences of honey, chocolate and caramel and has notes of vanilla, sandalwood, and patchouli, accompanied by fruity notes of fresh citrus, melons, peaches, and plums.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau Extraordinaire Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Introduced in 2014, this feminine floral fragrance opens with top notes of Tunisian neroli, bergamot, tea, a heart of Tiare flower, heliotrope, orange blossom, pepper, and ylang-ylang, and a base of white amber, cashmeran, sandalwood, vanilla, and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum 30ml Gift Set
listings.description: Mugler the maker of beauty classic Angel brings you Alien a fragrance which stands out from the crowd and isn't afraid to be different. The unique and distinctive woody amber solar floral fragrance consists of two powerful top notes.The woody note is distinctive mysterious and stimulates the imagination. Within this combination of luxurious, unusual notes is a floral lightness of Jasmine Sambac a gentle yet powerful flower with delicate petals that blooms under the Indian sun and gives off a bewitching scent with a hint of green notes and orange blossom.

listings.rawTitle: Thierry Mugler A*Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set
listings.description: Amen by Thierry Mugler, offers an unexpected shock of woody and fiery notes. Notes include lavender, bergamot, peppermint, roasted coffee, patchouli, styrax, caramel, tonka bean, musk and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Azzurro Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Azzurro is a luminous celebration of the beauty of the Mediterranean coast. It blends soft and delicate notes of dewy flowers with a bright aromatic counterpoint, evoking the caressing sea breeze. Between charm and sensuousness, this evocative fragrance weaves a unique tale of seduction. The Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Azzurro woman exudes cheerfulness and joie de vivre. She is free spirited, moving through her life with grace and elegance. Her natural charm is irresistible, her spontaneous laughter infectious. At ease with herself, she effortlessly conquers the hearts of others.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph Fresh Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity fragrance for modern women.Crisp sharp clean carefree & uplifting.Top notes are lemon watermelon & mandarin orange.Middle notes are magnolia freesia & rose.Base notes are white lily woodsy accord & musk.Launched in 2015.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa, inspired by the infamous 'Luna Rossa' boat created in 1997 for the America's Cup. Taking the esteemed Luna Rossa name as its own, it is a masculine scent with a reverence for the natural world and a passion for innovation. The bottle and packaging are inspired by the technological excellence and sleek, dynamic beauty of extreme sailing boats, both displaying the iconic red Prada stripe. Prada Luna Rossa is a masculine fragrance that reinterprets traditional ingredients with agility.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum is the lively, fun-filled fragrance in the Prada range. It is a modern perfume from this classic brand; celebrating life and colour and happiness. This is the perfume for Prada's next generation. It's funky and fun and full of life; not to mention that it's sexy and completely irresistible.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Eau de Parfum 80ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F64FB5B]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Olympea Perfume offers an exciting collection of fragrances. When you need to add to your perfume collection, you should find out what the range has to offer. Paco Rabanne Olympea launched this new fragrance in 2015. Since then, the range has continued to grow. New products including body care have been added. What can you expect from Olympea Perfume? The fragrance is a perfume you can wear at any time of the day or night. It has an interesting range of nuances. Sweetness comes from vanilla and white flowers. Amber and wood are responsible for the perfume’s sensual side. You can also pick up on warm spices and balsamic notes. Freshness is contributed by citrus and salt. This is an eau de parfum with a difference. Perhaps you are already a fan? We are pleased to offer the perfume in an 80ml format. Buy it for yourself as a personal treat or gift to someone who appreciates top-class perfumes from a premier brand.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Nuit D'Issey Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UJXBTP7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake Aftershave is one of the leading fragrances for men. When you are looking for a scent which makes a unique statement, but does not overpower, Issey Miyake Nuit D'Issey is the scent for you. We are delighted to be able to offer this exclusive scent so that you can complete your scent collection. What does Issey Miyake Nuit D'Issey Parfum smell like? The opening statement is of bold fresh citrus. As the citrus starts to drift, you will pick up on more masculine nuances including pepper. This scent is the perfect blend between masculinity and freshness. It is a scent that you are not going to forget in a hurry. The eau de parfum bottle looks understated but at the same time elegant. When you are looking for a gift for a man, it has to be said this fragrance never fails to please. Buy it for someone special or for yourself as a personal treat.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Glace Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Viva La Juicy Glace features a cool crisp fragrance capturing the glamour of ice and snow. Sorbet flavoured by mandarin, pear and cassis creates a chilled but fruity opening. Jasmine and orange blossoms mingle into a bittersweet bouquet and finally a base of creamy sandalwood, amber and smooth vanilla finishes the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=L1AIL3H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Distinctly masculine base notes of rum, sandalwood, cedarwood, vanilla, incense and modern musk fuse with a heady citrus cocktail to express the elegant, calm, warm and slightly mysterious character of a Lacoste man.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: La Vie Est Belle' is a French expression meaning life is beautiful. An eau de parfum with the noblest ingredients i.e. concrete of iris pallida, jasmine sambac, absolute orange blossom and absolute patchouli essence. Unique olfactory signature exclusively created for Lancôme by three of France's leading perfumers. Set comprises of 50ml EDP Spray and 50ml Body Lotion.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Dream Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Light and airy, Daisy Dream captivates with its delectably fruity and floral personality. From the first hints of blackberry, fresh grapefruit and succulent pear, Daisy Dream draws you in with her easy charm and an irresistibly feminine mix of jasmine flower, lychee and blue wisteria. The fragrance lingers on the skin, drying down to a dreamy finish of white woods, musk, and an elusive hint of coconut water.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Charmingly simple with a signature quality, Daisy Marc Jacobs transports you to a place that optimistic, beautiful and pure. The top of the fragrance is infused with succulent wild berries and soft white violets. At the heart, velvety jasmine warms to a dreamy drydown of sensual sandalwood, for a romantic, lingering finish.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray Gift Set
listings.description: Sophisticated but not too serious, Daisy Eau So Fresh sparkles with a sunny, vibrant energy. A spirited incarnation of the original Daisy, this fragrance excites the senses with a bright elegance and whimsical charm. Like the woman who wears it, Daisy Eau So Fresh inspires us to be bold and feminine, sweet and unpredictable. The scent's enticing top notes of raspberry and grapefruit sparkle on the skin like sunshine, deepening into a sensuous heart of wild rose and a musky, sophisticated finish of warm plum and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WUGBG27]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Marc Jacobs Perfume offers some of the best scents in the world. If you already have a scent from this top-class brand in your fragrance collection, you will know that all perfumes from the brand are world class. Marc Jacobs Honey is a must-have when you enjoy exclusive fragrances. It comes in a delightful bottle that makes a statement in its own right. Marc Jacobs Honey Perfume is a true scent experience. The first notes are of punch, mandarin and pear. Let the fragrance linger, and you will pick up honeysuckle, orange and blossom. The finish is packed with softer notes including vanilla, and wood. Of course, there is honey sweet offering in there as well. This is a fragrance that has it all. Honey Marc Jacobs is a wonderful scent. It is too gorgeous to miss out on. The sooner you can give this perfume a try, the better.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set
listings.description: An intoxicating, powerful blend. Starts out fresh – moves into a spicy leather accord. An arresting alchemy of full-on seduction. 1 Million was inspired by Paco Rabanne's metallic fashions, and in particular a 1967 dress worn by singer Françoise Hardy. A striking contrast combining refined sensuality and asserted virility. 1 Million is the expression of every man's fantasies.

listings.rawTitle: One Direction That Moment Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The response to One Direction’s debut fragrance, Our Moment, has been phenomenal, so much so that the band have created a stunning new Special Edition fragrance, called That Moment. The soft fragrance is made up of splashes of fresh fruit and seasonal flowers infused with an undertone of musk. The smell of green apple and refreshing cucumber, combined with peony and violet and a hint of cedarwood offers all the excitement of new beginnings. The fragrance is housed in an intricate pink glass bottle, complimented with a unique exclusive glass 'diamond' giving the bottle a stunning, luxurious finish.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Gift Set
